stories.title: Parties clash over Ukraine, North Korea and Supreme Court nominee as annual audit kicks off

en.title: Parties clash over Ukraine, North Korea and Supreme Court nominee as annual audit kicks off
en.summary: South Korea's parliamentary audit began Tuesday with partisan disagreements regarding government policies on North Korea and Ukraine, plus ongoing tensions between the presidential office and judiciary over a Supreme Court nomination. Eight of 17 standing committees started their inspections, with the three-week audit scheduled through October 27.
